data.name: Pack Or Die
data.detailed_description:
Survive a relentless journey through a post-apocalyptic world where every decision starts with your inventory.

As your character automatically pushes forward and fights through hordes of zombies, it’s up to you to manage the weapons, ammo, and supplies packed into your limited inventory case. Poor planning and slow decision making can leave you unprepared when things get worse.

Inspired by classic inventory systems, the game challenges you to think strategically under pressure. Rearrange your gear, optimize your limited space, adapt your loadout, and prepare for increasingly difficult encounters.

Every run puts your planning and resource management to the test. Do you prioritize firepower, stock up on supplies, or save precious space for whatever comes next?

Key Features:

  • Inventory management inspired by classic systems

  • Automatic combat against relentless hordes of zombies

  • Strategic management of weapons, ammo, and supplies

  • Limited inventory space

  • Increasingly dangerous encounters as you progress

  • Different loadout strategies that encourage replayability

Master your case, adapt your strategy, and survive the apocalypse.
